about.author: @Kaiconure
about.notes: This action should be placed at the top of your idle actions list. Set the vars.ensure_trusts.spells variable in your actions file to customize the trusts.

actions.name: call_trusts
when: me.is_party_leader and not a10 and not a20

actions.name: recall_trusts.debuff
when: me.is_party_leader and not a10 and not a20 and actionType == 'idle'
commands: log('Release/recall trust', result.name, 'due to debuff', effect.name)
num_trusts > 1 and (vars.ensure_trusts.stationary or result.distance <= 5 or move(result.x, result.y, 5, -1))
num_trusts > 1 and sendCommand('input /refa all') or releaseTrust(result.name)
